name: Great Sand Dunes National Park
summary: The tallest sand dunes in North America, piled improbably against snow-capped peaks — climb them, sled them, and splash in the seasonal creek at their base.

lodging.name: An Alamosa hotel
lodging.blurb: The nearest town to the dunes.

foodMustTry.name: San Luis Valley Mexican food
foodMustTry.blurb: Green chile in the high valley.

item.title: Great Sand Dunes
item.blurb: Hike (and sandboard down) 750-ft dunes beneath the Sangre de Cristos, with Medano Creek at the base in late spring.

commute.from: Great Sand Dunes National Park, CO
commute.scenicNote: West over Wolf Creek Pass to Mesa Verde.
